content.value_statement: Hybrid networking projects need secure routes, resilient links, and clear cloud provider choices. This skill guides VPN, dedicated connectivity, routing, security, monitoring, and cost decisions.
actual_capabilities: Compares VPN, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and GCP Cloud Interconnect options.
Provides Terraform examples for AWS and Azure VPN gateway resources.
Explains hub-and-spoke, multi-region, and multi-cloud hybrid network patterns.
Outlines BGP route advertisement and route propagation considerations.
Lists security, availability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and cost practices for hybrid links.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not a complete deployable network module.
It does not validate real cloud quotas, pricing, provider availability, or account permissions.
It does not replace vendor design review for regulated or high-risk production networks.
Referenced supporting files may not be included with the published skill package.

use_cases.title: Plan a Data Center Extension
use_cases.description: Choose between VPN and dedicated connectivity for extending existing workloads into a cloud VPC or VNet.

use_cases.title: Design Resilient Hybrid Routing
use_cases.description: Map BGP, route propagation, and failover patterns for active-active or multi-region connectivity.

use_cases.title: Review Operational Readiness
use_cases.description: Check monitoring, troubleshooting, security, availability, and cost controls before a hybrid network launch.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Connection Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me compare site-to-site VPN, dedicated cloud connectivity, and partner interconnect options for a hybrid cloud project.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Hybrid Network Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a hub-and-spoke hybrid network connecting one data center to AWS and Azure. Include routing, security, and availability notes.

prompt_templates.title: Review BGP and Failover
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned BGP route advertisements and failover model for dual hybrid cloud links. Identify risks and missing controls.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Production Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production readiness checklist for a multi-cloud hybrid network. Cover monitoring, incident response, encryption, cost, and compliance evidence.

output_examples.input: I need to connect a data center to AWS for moderate bandwidth and strict encryption needs.
output_examples.output: The response recommends site-to-site VPN as a first step, describes dedicated connectivity tradeoffs, and lists routing, tunnel redundancy, monitoring, and security checks.

output_examples.input: We need a resilient architecture across AWS, Azure, and on-premises locations.
output_examples.output: The response outlines a multi-cloud hybrid pattern, BGP design points, failover considerations, traffic segmentation, and operational monitoring requirements.

output_examples.input: Our VPN tunnels are unstable and we need a troubleshooting path.
output_examples.output: The response prioritizes tunnel status, packet loss, latency, BGP session health, route propagation, and provider telemetry checks.

best_practices: Use provider documentation and current quotas to confirm bandwidth, latency, and availability assumptions.
Design redundant links and routing policies before moving critical workloads across the hybrid boundary.
Pair network diagrams with monitoring, alerting, and incident response steps for each connection.
anti_patterns: Do not copy example CIDR ranges, ASNs, or addresses into production without review.
Do not rely on a single VPN tunnel for critical hybrid workloads.
Do not expose private workloads over the public internet when private endpoints or dedicated links are required.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy cloud networking resources?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning guidance and examples that an engineer can adapt and validate.

faq.question: Which cloud providers are covered?
faq.answer: The skill covers AWS, Azure, and GCP hybrid connectivity options at a practical design level.

faq.question: Can it help choose VPN or dedicated connectivity?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares cost, bandwidth, latency, reliability, and setup tradeoffs for common hybrid options.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights encryption, private connectivity, network controls, flow logs, DDoS protection, and audits.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot live cloud connections?
faq.answer: It can suggest diagnostic steps, but live troubleshooting requires authorized cloud access and provider-specific context.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated production environments?
faq.answer: Use it as a planning aid. Regulated production networks still need formal review, testing, and documented approvals.
